page.notes: The line "Bene oravisse, est penè studuisse" is struck through or underlined in the scan; I have transcribed the words as printed. "recef-su" is a line-end hyphenated word, written here as recess-u with the long s as plain s. The Greek-free text has no doubtful readings beyond these. Underlining in the text under "Quamvis", "gratus pro datis" and "dandis". "dignus" is hard to read at the line edge, and "texant" in the last line is doubtful. The Greek word ἀδιαλείπτως is read from a small scan and may contain small errors.
